title: Indra developing Ku/Ka-band satellite communications terminal for Eurodrone
excerpt: Indra is developing a new satellite communications terminal sized for medium and large RPAS platforms including Eurodrone, transmitting across both civilian and military Ku and Ka bands to give operators flexibility across different satellite constellations by region (source: https://www.indragroup.com/en/news/indra-developing-satellite-communications-system-long-endurance-defence-drones-future).

title: Eurodrone (U950/MALE RPAS) program overview
excerpt: Eurodrone (Airbus designation U950) is a twin-turboprop Medium Altitude Long Endurance Remotely Piloted Aircraft System (MALE RPAS) developed jointly by Germany, France, Italy, and Spain, managed by OCCAR (source: https://occar.int/our-work/programmes/male-rpas-medium-altitude-long-endurance-remotely-piloted-aircraft-system).
